policy: Bounded first-party alpha entropy investigation; preserve each source identity and distinguish diagnostic group costs from exact complete public outputs.

publicBefore.policy: Public alpha entropy comparison; exact alpha and unchanged decoded colors in both pinned independent decoders.

publicAfter.policy: Public alpha entropy comparison; exact alpha and unchanged decoded colors in both pinned independent decoders.

nativeFixtures.policy: Native 8/16-bit exact alpha at all five input levels, regular/progressive and edge groups. Both independent normalized float grids must retain their complete baseline hashes.

memoryControls.policy: Copied retained first-party baseline encoder controls; repeated-alpha regression must fail on old source. Exact native alpha, unchanged decoded colors, and explicit memory limits.

groupCosts.policy: Group-local alpha entropy controls using first-party Modular writer; no emitted public artifact or quality ranking.
